def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    twos = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    sevens = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]
    out = [[1] * w for _ in range(h)]

    vm = next(((r, c) for r, c in twos if r == 0 or r == h - 1), None)
    hm = next(((r, c) for r, c in twos if c == 0 or c == w - 1), None)

    vaxis = vm[1] if vm else None
    haxis = hm[0] if hm else None

    def move(points, dr, dc):
        for r, c in points:
            rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = 7

    if vm and hm:
        for top in (True, False):
            for left in (True, False):
                pts = [
                    (r, c) for r, c in sevens
                    if r != haxis and c != vaxis
                    and (r < haxis if top else r > haxis)
                    and (c < vaxis if left else c > vaxis)
                ]
                if pts:
                    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
                    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
                    dr = -rmin if top else h - 1 - rmax
                    dc = -cmin if left else w - 1 - cmax
                    move(pts, dr, dc)

    elif vm:
        edge = "top" if vm[0] == 0 else "bottom"
        for left in (True, False):
            pts = [(r, c) for r, c in sevens
                   if c != vaxis and (c < vaxis if left else c > vaxis)]
            if pts:
                rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
                cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
                dr = -rmin if edge == "top" else h - 1 - rmax
                dc = -cmin if left else w - 1 - cmax
                move(pts, dr, dc)

    elif hm:
        edge = "left" if hm[1] == 0 else "right"
        for top in (True, False):
            pts = [(r, c) for r, c in sevens
                   if r != haxis and (r < haxis if top else r > haxis)]
            if pts:
                rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
                cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
                dr = -rmin if top else h - 1 - rmax
                dc = -cmin if edge == "left" else w - 1 - cmax
                move(pts, dr, dc)

    # Draw each beam from its boundary marker up to the farthest original
    # 7 on its axis, preserving those 7 cells.
    if vm:
        c = vaxis
        aligned = [r for r, cc in sevens if cc == c]
        if aligned:
            end = max(aligned) if vm[0] == 0 else min(aligned)
            rows = range(0, end + 1) if vm[0] == 0 else range(end, h)
            for r in rows:
                if grid[r][c] != 7:
                    out[r][c] = 2

    if hm:
        r = haxis
        aligned = [c for rr, c in sevens if rr == r]
        if aligned:
            end = min(aligned) if hm[1] == w - 1 else max(aligned)
            cols = range(end, w) if hm[1] == w - 1 else range(0, end + 1)
            for c in cols:
                if grid[r][c] != 7:
                    out[r][c] = 2

    for r, c in sevens:
        if (vm and c == vaxis) or (hm and r == haxis):
            out[r][c] = 7
    for r, c in twos:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
